$comment: The words of the controls that keep a question on the Build page: pin it, and save it to My questions (D-125). Interface words, not sentences about the data. A sentence that names a date or a month is a notice in config/presets.json (builder.notices), which the template lint holds to config/narrative/rules.json. Kept apart from presets.json so the Explore page, which reads that file, does not download them.
heading: My questions
intro: Save a question to come back to it. A saved question opens on the newest month. Pin it to keep its window where the chart can hold one.
browser_only: Saved in this browser only. Nothing is sent anywhere, and the list does not follow you to another browser or device.
empty: Nothing saved yet. Save the question above and it is listed here.
unavailable: This browser is not letting the page keep a list, so questions cannot be saved or listed here. Build works as usual. Copy the link in the address bar to keep a question.
save_failed: The browser would not keep the list, so nothing was saved. Build works as usual. Copy the link in the address bar to keep the question.
unreadable: Saved questions that could not be read were left out of the list: {count}.
status_full: The list holds up to {max} questions. Remove one to save another.
status_copy_failed: The list could not be copied. Select the text and copy it.
